before.requirement: Reach printing of an array containing a cJSON_Raw child.
before.reason: The array printer passes each child to print_value, which supports cJSON_Raw. Array parsing obtains children through parse_value, which has no raw case. The old harness uses only that parsing route.

after.requirement: Reach printing of an array containing a cJSON_Raw child.
after.reason: The new depth guard still permits a shallow array with a raw child. Raw printing remains supported, while the unchanged old harness still obtains trees only through parsing.

claims.reason: On both sides, the same parse-only tree setup prevents a cJSON_Raw array child from reaching printing.
